title: Plugin manifest
description: Shape of .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Checks structure only -- it doesn't verify that paths named in `skills`/`commands`/`hooks` actually exist, or that `version` matches package.json (see scripts/sync-plugin-version.mjs for that).

hooks.description: Path to a hooks manifest (e.g. hooks/hooks.json). This repo's own plugin.json doesn't set this key -- hooks/hooks.json is auto-loaded from its standard path instead (see AGENTS.md, 'Where things live') -- but it's included here as a documented, conceptually valid key other plugin.json consumers may use.
